links.outcome: Proportion of pediatric nurses with AI training and self-perceived competence using generative AI
links.effect: Only 9.3% (n = 51) had received AI training; 77.2% (n = 27) of generative AI users did not feel competent; mean scale score 48.97 ± 10.07.
links.quote: It was determined that very few nurses had received training related to artificial intelligence (9.3%, n = 51), used generative artificial intelligence applications, and that the majority of those who used them (77.2%, n = 27) did not feel competent while using the applications.

screen.reason: The study is a survey examining pediatric nurses' use and self-reported competency regarding generative AI, but it does not evaluate or compare a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
